title: Keep an identity path around each learned update
description: A quick reference for the residual-stream, merge, and reverse-gradient terms used here.

terms.definition: A merge adding a learned branch update to its unchanged input tensor.
A route carrying the input unchanged around a learned transformation.
A learned mapping producing a same-shaped update for the stream.
A common-width hidden representation carried through successive Transformer sublayers.
A branch output added coordinatewise without increasing the feature width.
Residual addition requiring both inputs to share every dimension exactly.
A reverse-mode contribution mapping an upstream gradient through the learned branch.
The gradient arriving from later computations at a residual block's output.
Addition of identity-path and branch-path contributions at their shared input.
The local derivative of the learned branch with respect to its input.
